real_production_bug_found_and_fixed.symptom: public /ops/login/ POST returned a real 500 (ProgrammingError) for any credentials, caught only by an actual Chromium request against the live URL -- Django TestCase always runs under a full-privilege role and cannot catch a restricted-role permission gap
real_production_bug_found_and_fixed.root_cause: provision_db.py (db_setup) unconditionally REVOKEs ALL then re-GRANTs only its own blanket SELECT-only baseline on every run, with no knowledge of db_grants's narrower extra privileges. Two standalone 'docker compose run --rm migrate ...' invocations after the initial upgrade (create_operator, then a verification shell command) each re-triggered db_setup as an ordinary dependency, silently stripping web's BON-22 write grants both times
real_production_bug_found_and_fixed.fix: restored grants with 'docker compose run --rm --no-deps db_grants'; verified via direct psycopg probe as the real metacritic_web role (INSERT into django_session/processing_loginfailure succeeded); deploy/README.md now documents --no-deps for any standalone migrate/db_setup invocation post-deploy, committed as 47de33d before continuing verification
real_production_bug_found_and_fixed.verification_after_fix: same Chromium request against the public login page now returns 200 with the generic 'Invalid username or password.' message instead of 500
